subcategory: expandable search toolbar with spring animations
use_cases: Expandable search toolbar for notes or document applications
Mobile-friendly navigation that saves horizontal space when collapsed
Quick access search input with smooth spring-based animations
Floating action toolbar anchored to bottom of viewport
ai_summary: A dynamic expandable toolbar component that uses Framer Motion spring animations to transition between a compact icon-only state and an expanded 300px search input. Features a floating bottom-anchored design with click-outside detection, accessible button states with aria labels, and responsive hover/active feedback. Ideal for productivity apps, note-taking tools, or SaaS dashboards requiring contextual search functionality without permanent screen real estate usage.
